name: line-shadow-text

frames.best_why: The striped shadow behind the italic word is longest and most clearly hatched here.

tagline: An italic word trails a hatched shadow that slides across it.
summary: A line of large white text where one word is set in italic and carries a diagonal striped shadow behind it, slowly sweeping across on a loop.
appearance: Two oversized white words on black, an upright one followed by an italic one. Behind the italic word sits a fine diagonal-stripe shadow of the same letters, offset slightly down and right.
behaviour: The hatched shadow drifts diagonally across the italic word on a long fifteen-second loop, so the streaks seem to slide and gather behind the letters. The text itself stays still.
demo_content: The heading reads "Ship Fast" with "Fast" in italics.
search_phrases: text with sliding outline behind it
use_when: A hero headline needs one word to feel alive without pulling attention from the copy.
avoid_when: Long text: the effect only suits a short, very large word or two.
customise: Pass the word as a child and choose the shadow colour; the stripe angle, density and fifteen-second timing are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One text node with a CSS background-position keyframe; no canvas or script loop.

a11y.note: It is real text with decorative styling, so it reads fine; the endless loop ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

polish_why: Bold type and a distinctive hatched shadow; the streaks slightly muddy the italic letterforms.
